subject.title: ci: sign and notarize macOS release artifacts

question: Should the repository enable this credentialed CI release workflow after a controlled end-to-end validation of the signing, notarization, and publication path?
rationale: The source changes define a new production credential boundary and release authority; only a repository owner can confirm the required GitHub secrets, Apple credentials, and operational rollout are intended.

options.title: Validate with a controlled prerelease
options.body: Run the complete signing, notarization, verification, and publication flow using a controlled prerelease or equivalent safe release exercise before relying on it for the next stable tag.

options.title: Approve the new release boundary now
options.body: Accept the operational risk and enable the workflow based on code review and the existing local validation claims.

recommendation.title: Validate with a controlled prerelease
recommendation.body: Run the complete signing, notarization, verification, and publication flow using a controlled prerelease or equivalent safe release exercise before relying on it for the next stable tag.
